title: Public safety unions expand endorsements alongside new survey saying the city is on the wrong track
publisher: Santa Monica Daily Press (news report of the joint endorsements)
notes: Joint endorsement by Santa Monica Firefighters IAFF Local 1109 and the Santa Monica POA reported by SMDP; the unions' own pages were not found. No endorsements reported in SMMUSD, SMC or Rent Control Board races.

verify.general: yes: SMDP article (Sept 16, 2026) says the council election is 'Nov. 3' and the unions polled likely November 2026 voters; all three are on the Nov 3, 2026 Santa Monica City Council ballot.
verify.note: SMDP attributes the endorsements jointly to Santa Monica Firefighters IAFF Local 1109 and the Santa Monica POA (quotes from both presidents): Trussler and Oelsen added to the earlier Negrete endorsement. No own-group page found: santamonicafirefighters.org is a parked redirect; smff1109.org, smfa1109.org, iaff1109.org do not resolve; local1109.org is a different union. No betterUrl.

note: Transcribed from the page by a researcher. Firefighters' union (IAFF affiliate) for Santa Monica that endorses in city races. General election: "Article dated September 16, 2026: the unions expanded their council endorsements "ahead of the Nov. 3 election"."
